result.Method of Attack: SQL Injection via multiple stacked SQL statements allowing termination of read-only transaction with COMMIT; and execution of arbitrary write operations; Session state manipulation via connection pool reuse allowing persistent session variable changes
result.Discoverer: Security researcher (anonymous) reported on HackerOne November 27, 2024; Datadog engineer reported April 1, 2025
result.Impacted Systems: Anthropic's reference Postgres MCP server; Any system using @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres MCP server for PostgreSQL integration
result.Attack Vector: User-supplied SQL query string allowing multiple semicolon-delimited statements executed in one query; Reuse of connection pool sessions without isolation
result.Indicators of Compromise: NPM package @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres v0.6.2 (unpatched); Docker image mcp/postgres (unpatched); Proof of concept exploit at https://github.com/DataDog/security-labs-pocs/tree/main/proof-of-concept-exploits/postgres-mcp
